title: Aimfox workspace provisioning · input
description: Body of POST /webhook/workspace-setup-aimfox, and the item passed to the executeWorkflowTrigger. Sent by the orm-gateway `requestWorkspaceSetup` action. The gateway never forwards a vendor credential — the master key lives only as an n8n credential (process doc, invariant 7).

client_id.description: public.clients.id. The workflow resolves the client name from it; the caller never supplies the name, so a renamed client cannot silently target a different workspace.

workspace_id.description: Aimfox workspace UUID. When present it wins outright and no name search happens — this is how the operator answers a `needs_selection` result. When absent the workflow resolves by exact name match.

dry_run.description: true performs every read and no write, and returns the same `steps` object as a real run. This is what the portal's "Check" button sends, and what feeds the status column.

requested_by.description: profiles.id of the internal user who pressed the button, or null when the run was triggered by client creation. Recorded in integration_sync_runs.metadata for audit — provisioning writes into a client's sending system, so who asked is part of the record.
